headline: Front-Line Activity Cools as Contested Sectors Hold
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger shows a quieter base picture, though several battle lines remain under heavy pressure. LinnMercyHex has fallen from a burst of ten events in two hours to one, with twelve events in six hours and twenty-four across the day; ownership remains ten Colonial bases and one Warden. StonecradleHex likewise records no events in two hours and three in six, while its divided line—six Colonial and three Warden bases—sits amid sharply accelerating casualties. WeatheredExpanseHex has also gone quiet at the base level, with no recent events and two in six hours, but remains split six Warden to three Colonial as losses accelerate. StlicanShelfHex reports no events in six hours and four in twenty-four, holding five Warden and four Colonial bases. Newer movement is visible in FishermansRowHex, where two events in two hours included a Warden capture, leaving one Warden and eight Colonial bases. OarbreakerHex logged three events in six hours, its nine Colonial bases unchanged. DeadLandsHex and MooringCountyHex each retain five daily events but have gone quiet recently.
